jobs.title: [Job-32182] Project Manager – Tax Reform, São Paulo, SP / Rio de Janeiro,RJ
jobs.description: Na CI&T , ajudamos grandes empresas a transformar o potencial da AI em impacto real nos negócios com AI Deployment, execução AI-native e tech-integrated business solutions. Com 30 anos de experiência em transformação tecnológica, aceleramos inovação com expertise em agentic SDLC, application modernization, Data & AI, martech e business strategy. Somos 8.000 CI&Ters em mais de 25 países, colaborando para construir soluções com impacto real. AI já faz parte da forma como trabalhamos, evoluímos e inovamos todos os dias. Importante: se você reside na Região Metropolitana de Campinas, sua presença nos escritórios da cidade será obrigatória, conforme a política de frequencia vigente. Vaga hibrida em São Paulo ou Rio de Janeiro A CI&T busca uma pessoa Gerente de Projetos para atuação em uma instituição financeira, apoiando uma iniciativa estratégica relacionada à Reforma Tributária. Essa pessoa será responsável pela condução do projeto de ponta a ponta, fazendo a interface entre áreas de negócio, Tax/Tributário, tecnologia e demais stakeholders envolvidos, garantindo evolução das entregas, acompanhamento de riscos, dependências, prioridades e tomada de decisão. Buscamos um perfil com experiência em ambientes corporativos complexos e de alta pressão, preferencialmente em bancos ou grandes instituições financeiras, com capacidade de transitar entre diferentes áreas, lidar com prioridades concorrentes e conduzir discussões com stakeholders seniores. Responsabilidades: Gerenciar cronograma, escopo, riscos, dependências e entregas do projeto. Coordenar múltiplas frentes envolvendo negócio, Tax/Tributário e tecnologia. Apoiar a execução das iniciativas relacionadas à Reforma Tributária. Fazer a interface entre áreas tributárias, negócio, tecnologia, arquitetura e demais times envolvidos. Conduzir fóruns executivos e operacionais de acompanhamento. Atuar na resolução de impedimentos, conflitos e dependências entre áreas. Garantir alinhamento entre requisitos tributários, impactos sistêmicos e execução. Acompanhar prioridades e evolução das entregas em um ambiente de alta complexidade e forte governança. Requisitos para este desafio: Experiência relevante como Gerente de Projetos. Experiência prévia em bancos, instituições financeiras ou ambientes corporativos de alta complexidade. Experiência em projetos de Tax, Fiscal ou Tributário. Vivência em projetos envolvendo múltiplos sistemas, áreas e stakeholders. Boa capacidade de comunicação e gestão de stakeholders executivos. Perfil resiliente, pragmático, organizado e com boa capacidade de negociação. Capacidade de atuar em ambientes de alta pressão, com mudanças de prioridade e alto nível de cobrança. Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em São Paulo ou Rio de Janeiro, com presença no cliente de 3 a 4 vezes por semana. [Opcional] Diferenciais: Conhecimento ou experiência em projetos relacionados à Reforma Tributária. #LI-DJ1 #LI-midsenior

jobs.title: Intermediate Project Manager
jobs.description:
About BEES 

Join us to build the future of B2B commerce! 

BEES is AB InBev’s B2B platform. Through our ecosystem, merchants and retailers across 29 countries can stock their businesses quickly, easily, and securely. 
At BEES, we dream big, lead with purpose, and develop technology that transforms the way retailers and sellers grow. 

 Every line of code and every partnership is built in service of a single mission: to make commerce better for retailers and sellers around the world. Here, your work is not just important. It makes a difference! 

 About this opportunity 

We are looking for an Intermediate Project Manager to lead cross-functional technology initiatives that support business priorities and deliver measurable impact. This role is responsible for translating objectives into structured execution plans, coordinating multiple teams, and ensuring programs are delivered with clarity, quality, and predictability.

The ideal candidate combines strong program management fundamentals, technical understanding, business acumen, and effective stakeholder management. This person is able to navigate ambiguity, proactively manage risks and dependencies, and coordinate teams to drive execution.

The Intermediate Project Manager will typically be assigned to programs with moderate complexity and low to moderate business criticality, working primarily with cross-functional teams and managers. The role requires strong ownership and autonomy within the assigned scope, with the ability to recognize when topics require leadership escalation.

What you'll do

  • Lead cross-functional programs from planning and execution through delivery and post-launch stabilization.
  • Translate business and technology objectives into clear program plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables.
  • Coordinate Product, Engineering, Data, Operations, and Business teams to ensure effective execution.
  • Identify, track, and mitigate program-level risks, blockers, and dependencies.
  • Facilitate alignment and decision-making within the program scope by bringing structured analysis, context, and recommendations.
  • Establish and maintain appropriate program governance, tracking mechanisms, and status reporting.
  • Coordinate multiple teams and stakeholders across different functions and, when applicable, markets and time zones.
  • Ensure programs are delivered within agreed scope, timeline, quality, and business expectations.
  • Provide clear visibility into program progress, risks, dependencies, key decisions, and next steps.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams through influence, without direct authority.
  • Navigate ambiguity within the program scope and create clarity around priorities, ownership, timelines, and actions.
  • Recognize which topics can be resolved independently and which require leadership escalation.
  • Drive continuous improvement in program management practices, execution processes, and team ways of working.
  • Partner with Senior Program Managers and leadership on more complex or strategically critical initiatives when needed.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience in Program Management, Project Management, Product Management, or related roles within technology organizations.
  • Experience coordinating software development or technology initiatives involving multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Good understanding of software development lifecycle and Agile methodologies.
  • Ability to manage dependencies across Product, Engineering, Data, Operations, and Business teams.
  • Experience driving initiatives from planning through delivery and post-launch stabilization.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders and coordinate cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Experience working in cross-functional and matrixed environments.
  • Ability to identify and proactively manage risks, blockers, and dependencies.
  • Ability to translate business objectives into actionable execution plans.
  • Demonstrated ownership and accountability for program outcomes.
  • Ability to operate autonomously within the assigned scope and appropriately escalate critical topics.
  • Professional proficiency in English is mandatory, both written and spoken, with the ability to participate in meetings and effectively communicate with stakeholders.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience in Payments, Fintech, E-commerce, or Digital Platforms.
  • Experience working on multi-market or global initiatives.
  • Familiarity with APIs, system integrations, distributed systems, transaction processing, or financial operations.
  • Experience working with high-availability or business-critical systems.
  • PMP, Scrum, SAFe, or similar certifications.
  • Professional proficiency in Spanish.

What sucess looks like

  • Programs are delivered with predictable execution, clear ownership, and appropriate governance.
  • Risks, blockers, and dependencies are identified and managed proactively.
  • Teams have clarity on priorities, timelines, responsibilities, and expected outcomes.
  • Stakeholders have clear visibility into program health, risks, decisions, and next steps.
  • Cross-functional teams remain aligned throughout program execution.
  • Program-level decisions are facilitated effectively, with critical topics escalated at the right time.
  • Programs deliver the expected value within agreed scope, timeline, and quality.
  • Ambiguous situations are transformed into clear plans, actions, and ownership.
  • Program management practices continuously improve through lessons learned and structured execution.

Key Competencies

  • Program Management
  • Execution & Delivery
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Technical Acumen
  • Risk & Dependency Management
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Problem Solving
  • Communication
  • Ownership & Accountability
  • Influence Without Authority
  • Data-Driven Decision Making
  • Prioritization
  • Adaptability & Resilience

What we offer

  • Performance-based bonus*
  • Attendance bonus*
  • Private pension plan
  • Meal allowance
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance plans
  • Discounts on medications
  • Partnership with WellHub
  • Childcare assistance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • Clube Ben partnership
  • Scholarship program*
  • School supplies support
  • Language learning platforms and training
  • Transportation allowance 

*Applicable rules apply.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About BEES 

Join us to build the future of B2B commerce!

BEES is AB InBev’s B2B platform. Through our ecosystem, merchants and retailers across 29 countries can stock their businesses quickly, easily, and securely. At BEES, we dream big, lead with purpose, and develop technology that transforms the way retailers and sellers grow.

Every line of code and every partnership is built in service of a single mission: to make commerce better for retailers and sellers around the world. Here, your work is not just important. It makes a difference!

What you will do:

  • Provide servant leadership and mentorship to cross-functional agile teams delivering technology solutions
  • Identify and remove any impediments/distractions that interfere with the team’s ability to deliver against their commitments
  • Scope Management
  • Change Management
  • Strong stakeholder management and resource allocation capabilities
  • Maintain the product roadmap aligned between Engineering and Product
  • Raise, manage, and monitor risk mitigation plans
  • Implement, generate, and govern project metrics and KPIs to track team performance, delivery velocity, and quality outcomes; continuously refine measurement frameworks to drive data-driven improvements
  • Challenge and enable the team to continuously improve through intentional Lean and data driven inspect and adapt cycles (retrospectives)
  • Follow technical releases, escalating problems to the leadership Be constantly challenged to create world-class solutions

We are looking for people with:

  • University degree in computing-related fields such as Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or Systems Analysis and Development is preferred but not required (MBA/Master's is a plus)
  • Advanced communication skills in English (written and spoken)
  • Ability to understand technical issues at a high level
  • Proven experience with Agile projects and project management methodologies
  • Ability to work with minimal supervision in a very dynamic and time sensitive work environment.

Who should apply? 

  • You´re motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • You´re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You're a team player, who promotes collaboration
  • You demonstrate resilience, collaboration, and a growth mindset
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands; You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

What We Offer:

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus* 
  • Private pension plan
  • Meal Allowance
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Medicines discounts
  • WellHub partnership
  • Childcare subsidies
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • Clube Ben partnership
  • Scholarship*
  • School materials assurance
  • Language and training platforms
  • Transport allowance

*Rules applied

For more information: www.abinbev.com
